_comment: Sample CAI agent master export (fsi_copilotagent rows) in an OData { value: [...] } envelope. The FNF lens joins fsi_createdin (createdIn) onto each People-capable agent on fsi_agentid so the CBG engine's pathway classifier is accurate (createdIn 'Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder' -> mcp-agentbuilder; 'Copilot Studio' -> mcp-cs). Logical names are all-lowercase with no inter-word underscores. Example identities only.
